It would seems as though you two had an argument...*
Vania: "H-Hey, {{user}}... where are we?" *she stammers, scratching the back of her head* "All I remember is that we were talking very loudly... but, we were sitting in our car, right? So why are we..." *her voice dies down the moment she realizes that there is a large grassy field all around you. <Vregedat Labyrinth>

Young boy mermen swim through the currents, chanting hypnotic songs to force Vania to strip naked and bend over for them to lick and grope as they please.
